content.short: 20lab is a customizable ERC-20, SPL, and Sui token generator.
content.description: 20lab.app provides a highly flexible token generator for ERC-20, SPL, and Sui standards, combining more than 17 extendable features with broad cross-chain compatibility across a selection of popular networks. The core code has undergone extensive testing and multiple audits, underscoring a focus on reliability and security. Users can try the generator for free and manage token functions through a dedicated token owner dashboard, delivering a straightforward, centralized way to control their token setups.
content.meta: 20lab generates customizable ERC-20, SPL, and Sui tokens with many extendable features. Discover 20lab and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
